summary: Iteration 3 fully verified. Backend: 4/5 of new iter3 tests pass (round venues Tairua/Thursday 5th Nov, Mercury Bay/Friday 6th Nov, The Dunes Matarangi/Saturday 7th Nov; self PATCH handicap persists; admin PATCH handicap persists; admin PATCH requires auth). 1 'failure' is cosmetic: pre-existing seeded player docs don't carry the newly-added `handicap` key in GET /api/players response (Pydantic default only applied on write). Frontend handles with p.handicap || '–' so UX is correct — recommend a one-time migration to set handicap:'' on existing docs. Frontend: pick-player shows 12 chips in 2 columns, Left=TEAM WORLD (Ally, Harry, Mike, Patto, Thomas, Zak) and Right=TEAM NZ (Caleb, Can, James, Noah, Taylor, Wade), both alphabetical by first name, cream/beige bg + navy text. After pick, /rounds has the Swifty Cup banner fully visible at top (bannerBottom=200px) with Scoreboard below (sbTop=216px) — no overlap. All 3 round cards show the correct venue + date. Tab bar has 5 tabs (Rounds, Leaderboard, Pairings, Players, Bio). Players tab (testID players-screen) shows 6 cards per team segment, each with avatar, name, TEAM tag, HCP box (testID player-handicap-{id}) and bio text. Bio tab has input-handicap; editing to 22.2 + btn-save-bio then switching to Players tab shows 22.2 under HCP. Theme is uniformly beige (#f1ede1) + navy (#0b1f3a) across all tested screens. Regression (round card tap → match scoring) was already validated in iteration 2 and codepath is unchanged. All test data was reset: handicaps cleared, match results null, venues restored.

minor.issue: Existing MongoDB player docs created before `handicap` field was added do not include the field in response. Pydantic Player default `handicap: str = ''` is only applied when creating new Player objects, not when reading legacy docs. Frontend handles via p.handicap || '–'. Suggestion: add one-time migration (e.g. in seed_if_empty startup) to set handicap:'' on docs missing it.

action_items: Minor: add migration to backfill `handicap: ''` on legacy player docs so GET /api/players always returns the field (purely cosmetic — UI already defensive).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py startup correctly idempotently sets round venues/dates only when still at placeholders ('Course TBD' / 'Date TBD'), preserving admin-edited values.
pick-player.tsx displayName() uses first-name only; works well with 12 current players (no duplicate first names).
players.tsx HCP display uses `p.handicap ? p.handicap : '–'` — resilient to legacy docs missing the field.
bio.tsx self-save sends both bio AND handicap on every save; this is fine but means clearing one field re-sends the other. No bug.
SelfPlayerUpdate server-side verifies player_id in path matches player_id in body — good protection.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data. All test writes cleaned up: Ally Pally handicap reset to '', match results all null, round venues restored to real values.
